title: Have You Protected All That You Were Supposed to Protect?

lines.en: 「One person named Yoo Joonghyuk stood there.」
From the zeroth round to the 1863rd.
The years Yoo Joonghyuk had accumulated overlapped and rippled at the hem of his coat.
As if speaking for his Story, Yoo Joonghyuk's words appeared on the [Final Wall].
「“I don't forget a single thing.”」
[The special effect of the Story, ‘Life and Death Companions,’ is active!]
The Stories of the third-round Yoo Joonghyuk and the ‘Secretive Plotter’ were resonating together.
The terrifyingly brilliant power of Chaos streamed from the tip of the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] gripped tightly in his hand. The disorderly aura of Chaos shook the entire wall.
It was only natural.
His story must have formed the most important part of this wall.
Yoo Joonghyuk, the protagonist of 『Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World』.
Without Yoo Joonghyuk, none of these worlds could have begun in the first place.
The Dokkaebi King spoke with a sneer.
[Puppet of the Oldest Dream. Your film is truly long and vast.]
He spoke as though he had known Yoo Joonghyuk would come.
[No one will be able to stay with your tedious, bloated story to the end. Not even the ‘Oldest Dream.’]
Tsu-tsu-tsu-tsut!
As Yoo Joonghyuk slowly blinked, his [Sage's Eye] opened with a golden glow. Eyes blazing as though they had swallowed all the starlight in this world.
The owner of those eyes spoke.
【Have I come too early again?】
The moment I heard the ‘Secretive Plotter,’ a memory I had seen through [Disconnected Film Theory] came to mind.
A memory of the ‘Dokkaebi King’ he had met in the worldline of the 1863rd round.
「[Unfortunate puppet. You have come too soon. You cannot complete this universe.]」
As if receiving that memory in real time, the Dokkaebi King tilted his head and spoke.
[I see. Is that what I said in another worldline?]
【You speak differently from the one I saw.】
[Just as your rounds aren't all the same, neither am I.]
With an amused shrug, the Dokkaebi King pulled out Yoo Joonghyuk's [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] and flung it away. Yoo Joonghyuk caught the flying blade in his bare hand.
Where the sword had been pulled from the [Final Wall], a cut remained like a cursor.
Soon the cut moved backward, a handspan at a time, and sentences appeared on the wall.
「But all those worldlines ultimately exist to lead down the same path.」
As though immensely proud of that story, the Dokkaebi King spoke to Yoo Joonghyuk.
[The completion of a great world is at hand. You, too, can finally fulfill your long-cherished wish.]
I knew very well what Yoo Joonghyuk's wish was.
[Giant Story, ‘Lonely Pilgrim of Destruction,’ begins its story!]
To escape the bonds of this dreadful curse and become free.
Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round had lived for that goal alone.
「But that was not Yoo Joonghyuk's only goal.」
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ had turned his head and was looking at me.
The meaning of his gaze was clear.
He was telling me not to forget my promise to him.
「“I will eliminate the one responsible for all these worlds.”」
The Dokkaebi King read the sentence that appeared on the [Final Wall] and spoke.
[Eliminate······ How amusing. Do you still believe such a thing is possible?]
【It is possible. And for that to become possible.】
He held a sword in each hand.
The keen blade of [Splitting the Sky Sword] overlapped the pitch-black blade of the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword].
【First, you must cease to exist.】
With a boom, sparks battered the wall as though to shatter it. A series of flashes erupted, revealing two figures overlapping in midair.
I saw a solid barrier of Stories surrounding the ‘Dokkaebi King.’
A being who wielded the world's oldest stories as weapons.
[Giant Story, ‘First Messiah,’ begins its story!]
The very Story once possessed by the master of the nebula <Eden> flowed from his fingertips.
Tightly entwined sentences scattered a holy radiance. The light of a great constellation poured toward the creatures below.
That Status would surely melt a being out of existence at the slightest touch.
“Dokja-ssi!”
A horrified Lee Hyunsung hurried toward me.
Steel extended from his whole body, spreading to protect my companions and me. But I shook my head.
“There's no need, Hyunsung-ssi.”
“Pardon?”
Instead of answering, I pointed ahead.
Even through my throbbing headache, I didn't take my eyes off the sight unfolding before me.
The other stars were right. Perhaps I, too, was nothing more than a constellation. Perhaps I had endured more than ten years just to see this sight.
[Exclusive attribute, ‘Horror of the Stars,’ activates!]
Before my eyes, the Dokkaebi King's radiance was scattering.
The man in the black coat was meeting the messiah's light, which vanquished every evil in the world, with two swords.
Tsu-zu-zu-zu-zu······!
The Stories of the wall melted wherever the light touched them.

The ‘Secretive Plotter’―no, Yoo Joonghyuk―advanced against that light, step by step. Beads of sweat dripped from his chin, and the light was dulling the blades of the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] and [Splitting the Sky Sword], but he did not retreat an inch.
By then, the Dokkaebi King's expression had begun to change.
[I see. Then how about this?]
[Giant Story, ‘First Evil,’ begins its story!]
First Evil. It was the Story of ‘Baal,’ the ascended Great Demon King of the Demon Realm.
An overwhelming power that no Good in this world dared face.
With the entire Demon Realm at his back, the Dokkaebi King sent pitch-black lightning down upon Yoo Joonghyuk. Lightning of the fallen, which no archangel could withstand.
Lee Seolhwa shouted from afar.
“Joonghyuk-ssi!”
Yoo Joonghyuk didn't dodge the oncoming lightning. Instead, he held his sword upright like a lightning rod and met the bolt head-on. But that wasn't the end.
[「Stage Transformation」 activates!]

Through Stage Transformation, the souls of Demon Kings were reviving. Some were ones we had killed; others had died at the hands of the Apocalypse Dragon. All those Demon Kings had been summoned back to the battlefield by ‘First Evil’ and were howling at Yoo Joonghyuk.
Gwaaaaaaaa―!
The weapons thrown by the Demon Kings were shrouded in evil magic power, creating a purple lightning storm. A storm so powerful that even a Myth-grade constellation couldn't withstand it.
Amid the surging lightning, Yoo Joonghyuk's pale face shone like a demon's. Even in that ominous storm of Status, he was calm.
Like someone who had waited a very long time for this moment alone.
【I've killed every one of them before.】
[Exclusive attribute, ‘Demon King Slayer,’ activates!]
Leaping into the air, Yoo Joonghyuk advanced, deflecting the weapons. Wherever his sword traced an arc, Stories of Evil shattered.
Like a monster born solely for destruction, he swung his swords again and again. Every strike held the resentment of the worlds he had lived in.
Tsu-tsu-tsu-tsut!
A great crack was forming in the sky of the fallen Demon Realm.
The force to dismantle 「Stage Transformation」 single-handedly.
The monster the <Star Stream> had made was now moving to destroy the <Star Stream>.
Gwaaaaaaak!

The [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] beheaded the revived ‘Black Mane Lion,’ Marbas, while the arc of [Splitting the Sky Sword] pierced the heart of the charging ‘Merciless Hunter Against the Will of Heavens,’ Barbatos.
No Demon King could proclaim himself a king before him.
As if feeling threatened, the Dokkaebi King snarled.
[Arrogant puppet······ You are not the protagonist of this worldline.]
At the same time, the surrounding terrain began to change again.
[Giant Story, ‘Star Stream Game System,’ begins its story!]
[「Stage Transformation」 activates!]
The wall's scenery was turning into pixels.

Yoo Joonghyuk's body began to shrink. As if he were trapped in the ‘Labyrinth of Daedalus,’ the path ahead became a maze. I could also see a monster with an enormous mouth chasing him. [Automatic Turrets] sprang up everywhere and opened fire, while the ground beneath his feet turned into deep mire.
As though he had entered a game.
「Yoo Joonghyuk was smiling.」
[Exclusive attribute, ‘Ruler of Amusement,’ activates!]
Breaking through the traps with ease, Yoo Joonghyuk shot forward like an arrow. He tore open the crown of the approaching monster's head and smashed through the maze walls.
As if he had long known how to beat this world, he didn't allow a single blow to land.
[This ‘stage’ cannot withstand the target's Status!]
The maze collapsed, and suddenly Yoo Joonghyuk stood right before the Dokkaebi King.
Bewilderment filled the Dokkaebi King's eyes.
【Is that all?】
It was only natural that the ‘Secretive Plotter’ would defeat the Dokkaebi King.
Every life he had lived existed to fight and overcome the <Star Stream>.
In the part of the original story I hadn't read, Yoo Joonghyuk had probably killed the Dokkaebi King the same way.
Retreating, the Dokkaebi King glanced at me.
「What was Yoo Joonghyuk's weakness?」
The instant I read the sentence appearing on the [Final Wall], a chill ran down my neck.
Scenes from another worldline were appearing in the Dokkaebi King's eyes. Memories of a worldline other than this one were flowing into him.
As if he had found the answer, the Dokkaebi King looked away from me and turned an eerie smile toward Yoo Joonghyuk.
[Puppet. Is your mental fortitude as sharp as your sword?]
[The ‘King of Stories’ forcibly reenacts your Story!]
[「Stage Transformation」 temporarily activates!]
[Similarities in the nearby terrain raise the stage's reenactment level!]
Dead Demon Kings lay scattered everywhere. Amid the ruins of dead constellations and Demon Kings, Yoo Joonghyuk slowly looked around, his face desolate.
「The last world he had lived in was unfolding there.」
There was no way he wouldn't recognize that world.
Because it was the ‘Secretive Plotter’ who had sent me there.
「The 1863rd round. The last world of ‘Ways of Survival.’」
Like a shadow, the Dokkaebi King approached Yoo Joonghyuk, who was staring blankly at the sky. No, he was no longer the Dokkaebi King. With each step, his face and build changed.
「Pale cheeks. Two eyes shining like stars were looking at him.」
A white coat identical to mine fluttered in the wind.
[Remember? The 33rd round. What Lee Jihye said after you cleared scenario 40.]
A voice identical to mine was speaking.
As sparks leapt through the air, Yoo Joonghyuk's body stiffened.
The Dokkaebi King casually reached out, seized Yoo Joonghyuk by the collar, and continued.
[Think about it. You weren't always unhappy. Were you? In every one of those rounds, there were times, however brief, when you were happy.]
[Splitting the Sky Sword] and the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] shook violently.
Amid that trembling, both swords hung limply.
「Regression Depression.」
The only weakness of Yoo Joonghyuk, who had regressed over and over for so many years.
[The 173rd round. You protected Earth for quite a long time. You saw Lee Jihye receive her high school diploma, and Lee Seolhwa smiling with someone else's child in her arms.]
Yoo Joonghyuk's gaze was wavering.
「It isn't despair that breaks Yoo Joonghyuk.」
「Memories like tiny feathers were settling in his mind, one by one.」
The Dokkaebi King was using the very method I had used.
「Breath catches. Lungs constrict.」
「A drowning person sinks deeper beneath the surface under the weight of a single feather.」
I couldn't watch any longer.
I shouted at Yoo Joonghyuk. Told him to get a grip, not to fall for those illusions.
But as if a screen had appeared between us, my voice didn't reach him.
Only the Dokkaebi King was smiling, as though mocking all those stories.
[Yoo Joonghyuk. Have you protected everything you wanted to protect?]
Yoo Joonghyuk was slowly sinking to his knees.
I raised the Status of my Stories.
I had to dismantle that 「Stage Transformation」 right now. But how―
A tight grip.
Someone was still holding my hand firmly. Han Sooyoung.
“This isn't your battlefield.”
“But if we just leave him like that―”
“······You said even stars we can't see are shining.”
······Stars we couldn't see?
At Han Sooyoung's words, I looked back at Yoo Joonghyuk.
His sinking gaze had stopped. Dazzling sparks were consuming his entire body.
Tsu-tsu-tsu-tsu······.
Something was waking his fading mind.
[Giant Story, ‘Those Who Remember Ruin,’ begins its story!]
It was a Story I didn't know well.
Amid the slowly subsiding sparks, I could make out faint figures.
Looking closely, I saw that Yoo Joonghyuk wasn't alone. Four figures stood beside him.
A tall man, a white-haired young man, a woman with a ponytail, and―
【He failed to protect a single thing. That is why he is here now.】
An archangel with dazzling wings.
The Great Dokkaebi's expression filled with horror.
The Story of the ruined 999th round was burning like an inferno at the archangel's sword tip.
【Because he still believes there is something he must protect.】
The Dokkaebi King's brow twitched. The Stories of the 999th round spread before him.
Stories abandoned by the <Star Stream> were beginning to speak, one after another. They were waking Yoo Joonghyuk from his deep ‘Regression Depression.’
The Dokkaebi King frowned.
[Why have you come here? Didn't you make a contract with me? You have no grounds to help him.]
A sentence appeared on the [Final Wall].
「I even made a deal with the Dokkaebi King. If we just destroy this worldline, he'll let us go back to that time. He'll contact the captain's sponsor, the ‘Oldest Dream’―」
Those were the words of Lee Jihye from the 999th round.
The Dokkaebi King spoke again.
[I am the one who brought you into this world. Do you want to be abandoned by the worldlines again? Do you want to wander those dreadful dimensional rifts and taste eternal agony?]
The Dokkaebi King continued, his words a threat.
[That ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ is the enemy you were searching for. He is the one who destroyed your worldline and plunged your Stories into misery.]
A flicker of unease crossed the faces of the ‘Outer Gods.’
The Dokkaebi King was right. Like Yoo Joonghyuk, they had come this far to avenge the worlds they had lived in.
Then someone spoke.
【What bullshit. You're the bastard who dragged us into this game. If these scenarios had never started in the first place, would I be here doing this shit?】
It was the swaggering Kim Namwoon of the 999th round, the ‘Monarch of the Great Abyss.’
As if his mind were already made up, terrifying power of Chaos poured from his entire body.
[Giant Story, ‘Delusional Design,’ begins its story!]
【Khh, it's been ages since we all fought together.】
Kim Namwoon cackled and unwound the bandage on his hand.

A monster who had surpassed even his former sponsor, the ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon.’ His hand, black as obsidian and filled with an aura far denser and more evil than Han Sooyoung's, swallowed the night of the <Star Stream>.
[Giant Story, ‘Heart Sealing the Sorrow,’ begins its story!]
A hulking man was rising right behind him. Lee Hyunsung of the 999th round.
The ‘King of the Silver Heart.’ His entire body was encased in a full suit of ‘Story metal’ armor.
【Dokkaebi King. I have never made a contract with you, so that does not apply to me.】
Next was the ‘Master of the Sunken Island,’ Lee Jihye of the 999th round, floating her enormous battleship in the sky.
[Giant Story, ‘Wanderer of the Eternal Horizon,’ begins its story.]
I could feel the spirit of the vast ocean from her Twin Dragon Swords.
Silently drawing her sword, she guarded Yoo Joonghyuk's right flank.
With that, the kings' choice was clear.
[Exclusive skill, ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint,’ forcibly activates!]
Their thoughts and resolve were reaching me in full.
They all hated the ‘Secretive Plotter.’ But that hatred had ultimately sprung from a deep-rooted longing.
「In no universe were there people who cherished ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ as much as they did.」
They had all made it this far thanks to Yoo Joonghyuk.
To send them this far, Yoo Joonghyuk of the 999th round had sacrificed everything.
He had an arm severed and a leg cut off, lost both eyes, and finally sacrificed even his life.
「It was Yoo Joonghyuk who had saved them, and Yoo Joonghyuk who had killed them.」
They had lived thinking only of Yoo Joonghyuk. How could they forget him?

Anger that could only be contained by imprisoning oneself on a sunken island. Sorrow that could only be endured by covering one's heart in steel. Pain that could only be forgotten by throwing oneself into the abyss.
[Giant Story, ‘Flames of Eternity,’ begins its story!]
And the agony of having to burn oneself to atone. Joining and rejoining the film that never quite broke, they had finally reached the story's last chapter.
【Move aside, Dokkaebi King. There is only one thing we want.】
Uriel of the 999th round, ‘The Living Flame,’ spoke.
【To see here the ‘end’ we could not see in our own worldline.】
With those words, [Flames of Retribution] moved.
Kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa!
The [Hell Flames Ignition] that had devastated N'Gai's Forest burned the wall's interior.
Almost at the same time, the right hand of the 999th round's Kim Namwoon tore into the Dokkaebi King's thigh.
【Hahahaha! Let's kill ourselves a dokkaebi!】
Kim Namwoon's frenzied stigma slashed through spacetime, destroyed Stories, and aimed for the Dokkaebi King's torso.

An exchange of precise amounts of Story through attack and defense. Weapons given form by delusion sprouted from Kim Namwoon's right arm, and Star Relics summoned by the Dokkaebi King appeared throughout the wall to meet them.
Tsu-tsu-tsu-tsut!
The [Final Wall] was where the Dokkaebi King's Stories could wield their greatest power.
With the battlefield being what it was, the exchange was turning against Kim Namwoon.
「O spear that tears the sea and draws the boundary of the shore.」
「O arrow that shot down the sun's eye.」
Sentences flowing from all over the wall became tangible.
Shu-shu-shu-shuk!

Following the Dokkaebi King's hand signals, the flying Star Relics riddled the ‘Monarch of the Great Abyss.’ A spear lodged in his thigh, an arrow in his forearm. Dripping pitch-black Stories, Kim Namwoon laughed.
【Go! Taekwon Hyunsung!】
At Kim Namwoon's shout, someone took position behind the king.
Kwa-dudududu······.
It was Lee Hyunsung of the 999th round. As he restrained the Dokkaebi King with his sturdy arms, steel grew over his entire body, occupying the surrounding space.
Amid tremendous sparks, the steel bound the Dokkaebi King's arms and legs.
【Jihye!】
At the signal from the 999th round's Lee Hyunsung, the ‘Master of the Sunken Island’ moved.
【Load.】

Through the cracks made by the Ark's impact, I could see the enormous battleship floating in the night sky. At its very front, something swirled as it was being loaded. Enough Status to blow away an entire planet. Looking closely, I saw that what had been loaded into the enormous barrel wasn't a shell.
【Fire!】
With a thunderous roar, a meteor shot from the battleship.
A star falling with a dazzling tail. ‘The Living Flame.’

She had become the projectile herself, hurtling toward the Dokkaebi King. Uriel of the 999th round charged at terrifying speed, melting everything in her way. The Story of the 999th round, concentrated at her sword tip, burned fiercely.
【The Supreme King isn't the only one who has killed you before.】
「That was how the people of the 999th round had cleared the final chapter.」
The incandescent sun charged forward, smashing the wall's shell. The Stories clinging to the Final Wall writhed in agony at its heat.
A blow no one in this worldline could stop.
「The Dokkaebi King was meeting that blow.」
Grrrrrrrrrk―
Amid the hellish heat, the Dokkaebi King's eyes blazed.
Aaaaaaaaah!
Countless stigmas engraved over his entire body howled. They were letters that seemed to have been transferred from the [Final Wall]. Giant Stories bowed before them.
My own Stories were wavering, too.
「The modifier ‘King of Stories’ was not just for show.」
The ‘King of Stories,’ standing at the pinnacle of the <Star Stream>.
His face was sublime, evil, beautiful, and seemingly sad.
「He had once been human.」
Weapons pouring from the [Final Wall] collided with [Flames of Retribution].
「A devil.」
The gray Stories flowing from the Dokkaebi King's horns blocked the approaching Uriel.
「A savior.」
Holy light extending from white wings restored the Dokkaebi King's stamina.
「And a being who had finally become a dokkaebi.」
Unending Stories surrounded him.
As if this world could not end here.
「This was not the 999th round.」
I felt all the people of the 999th round turn toward me at once.
「Move.」
「You have to finish this.」
「You haven't forgotten your promise to us, have you?」
But I couldn't move.
[Giant Story, ‘Guardian of the World,’ begins its story!]
[Giant Story, ‘Guardian of the World,’ looks at the next guardian!]
Because the Dokkaebi King's Story, too, was looking at me.
[······Kim Dokja!]
The Dokkaebi King was shouting at me.
[Do not defy the fate ordained for you. You love Stories more than anyone in this world. So did I. More than anyone in this world, I understand what you feel for it!]
The Story extending from his entire body was approaching me.
Beside me, Han Sooyoung covered my ears and snarled.
“Don't listen. It's a story you don't even need to hear.”
Jung Heewon and Lee Hyunsung stepped in front of me, while Yoo Sangah, Shin Yoosung and Lee Gilyoung stood guard around me. Behind me, Lee Jihye's sword rang out.
[Every constellation of the nebula <Kim Dokja's Company> shines brightly!]
But some things can be seen more clearly the harder you try to block them.
Some words grow clearer the harder you try to hide them.
[Exclusive skill, ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint,’ runs wild!]
「[Black Flame Dragon! Black Flame Dragon! Fuck, won't you open your eyes?]」
「[Kim Yushin! Get a grip! Our Hwangsanbeol is still―]」
「[Great Sage, Heaven's Equal!]」
Stories flowing across the [Final Wall].

On a battlefield where the fighting was far more desperate than here, constellations were falling. Stories leaked endlessly from the Great Sage, Heaven's Equal, his body in tatters. Perhaps he had lost both eyes; the dazzling light of his Fiery Golden Eyes had gone out.
「[······I can't see our youngest.]」
Uriel supported him. Both wings torn, the archangel held his hand and brushed it across the nightscape.
「[He's safe. He's shining over there.]」
Through that hellish night sky, constellations that had stubbornly survived were flying toward them.
The scene changed, showing Persephone embracing the fallen Hades. When Hades tried to say something, Persephone shook her head.
「[Don't worry, my ancient night.]」
Above her head, the sun of <Olympus> was setting.
All those final moments became wretched sentences racing across the wall.
Sentences written solely to bring them to an end.
[Don't you want to save those stars?]
Nausea surged up from deep inside me.
The Dokkaebi King shouted.
[As you are now, you cannot save them. A being who loves a story can never change it.]
Because you love it, you cannot change it.
[Only a being who has escaped that story, who understands how insignificant it all is, can escape the oppression of probability.]
With a grinding crack, the backlash around us grew fiercer. Little by little, the power of the Stories pouring from the ‘Dokkaebi King’ was overwhelming that of the people from the 999th round.
Tearing through Lee Hyunsung's Story metal, the Dokkaebi King reached one hand toward me.
[‘A Single Story,’ which you have built, is enough for you to take the <Star Stream>'s place. Take my hand. I want the same thing you do. I don't want the stories of those stars to disappear.]
There was even desperation in the voice of the ‘Dokkaebi King.’
His eyes, his Story, told me he meant what he said.
The Story of the <Star Stream> shone brightly from his entire body.
「A story he has read for a very long time eventually becomes part of him.」
He was the <Star Stream> itself.
He truly did not want this story to end.

[Continue······ Continue this story. Become the protagonist of a new worldline, and with the Story you've made, continue the feast of the ‘Oldest Dream.’ You were born for that. For that alone, you were able to come this far!]
Hearing those words, I remembered the good fortune that had come my way until now.
[The <Star Stream> is looking at you.]
Why had the probability of the <Star Stream> been so generous to me?
The Dokkaebi King's Story was telling me why.
Flashes exploded one after another before my eyes.
[Don't forget what you truly want. You are not the ‘Final Chapter.’ You are ‘Eternity’!]
Behind the Dokkaebi King, the constellations' Stories were flowing.
He was right. I didn't want that story to end.
「Watching the falling meteor, the Great Sage, Heaven's Equal, sensed his death approaching.」
Slowly turning my head, I saw Yoo Joonghyuk, almost free of ‘Regression Depression.’ His empty eyes looked at me.
「But some stories had to end.」
It was a very old promise.
「“I'll end your story for you.”」
In the 1863rd round, I had failed to keep that promise.
[Your ■■ begins to waver!]
Rising, I gripped [Unbreakable Faith] tightly.
I felt the solid hilt of the sword that had accompanied me through nearly every scenario, from the beginning until now.
As its tip touched the floor, sentences appeared. Sentences I had never seen before.
「He was more curious than anyone about this world's end.」
「And wished more than anyone that this world would never end.」
My last Story was beginning.
“······Kim Dokja?”
I took Han Sooyoung's hands away from my ears.
Her gaze wavered. My bloodstained reflection showed in her eyes. A long cut across my cheek. Torn wings and broken Demon King's horns. A complete mess.
Han Sooyoung had come this far believing in that wreck of a human being.
[Have you made your choice?]
The Dokkaebi King asked from the center of the bursting sparks.

The people of the 999th round, the ‘Outer God Kings,’ were struggling desperately against him. Until now, the fight had been evenly matched, but judging by the direction of probability's backlash, the 999th round's side would eventually be at a disadvantage.
“Yes.”
I answered the Dokkaebi King.
“I'll cross the ‘Final Wall.’ And meet the one beyond it.”
The ‘Oldest Dream,’ the source of all these tragedies.
“I'll meet that being and stop all the tragedies in the world.”
As if satisfied with my choice, the Dokkaebi King smiled.
[Yes, good. That's possible if you become my successor. Now, come here. Hurry and inherit the will of the <Star Stream>―]
“I never said I'd accept your help.”
I activated [Way of the Wind] and [Electrification] at the same time.
Blue-white lightning wound around the fastest footwork in this world, turning my body into a mass of light. At the greatest speed I could muster, I raced past the Dokkaebi King and the Outer Gods.
My destination was the deepest part of the [Final Wall].
I heard the Dokkaebi King's startled shout.
In the distance, I could see sentences racing across the [Final Wall].
「The place where the Abyssal Black Flame Dragon's last scale and Uriel's last feather fall.」
Horrified, I ran toward that sentence.
「Where Persephone's last tear falls.」
I had to stop those sentences from ending. Even if I saw the end of this world, it couldn't end with those sentences.
Perhaps realizing my intent, the Dokkaebi King cried out in alarm.
[Stop! You haven't been granted permission yet. You cannot touch that wall or cross it!]
Tsu-tsu-tsu-tsu-tsut!
The moment he spoke, probability's backlash squeezed my whole body with terrifying force.
For an instant, my mind went blank under sparks that seemed ready to crush my incarnation body down to its molecules.
[The ‘Final Wall’ rejects your approach!]
The wall was rejecting me.
It was stopping me from touching its sentences, changing their contents, and going beyond them. As if my reaching that place at all could not be allowed.
The sentences of the wall abruptly expanded the space between us and fled far away.
「That sentence was not Kim Dokja's.」
A surging gale knocked me over. Like a word flung into the wrong blank space, I rolled miserably across the floor, driven backward. Something struck my back with a thump.
“Idiot! What do you think charging in alone like that will do?”
It was Han Sooyoung. I grinned and replied.
“I didn't charge in alone.”
Behind her, my companions from <Kim Dokja's Company> were running toward us.
I didn't want to lose anyone.
They were people I could not lose.
“Dokja-ssi! Keep running!”
Activating [Hour of Judgement], Jung Heewon came running, red light blazing from her eyes.
Lee Hyunsung and Lee Jihye guarded her flanks, while Yoo Sangah and the children followed. At the very rear came Jang Hayoung and the masters.
“Take this! It's the last Life and Death Pill!”
